notes.title: Announcing our new game: Pythagoria The Finals
notes.notes:
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/909710/Pythagoria_The_Finals/]Wishlist Pythagoria: The Finals[/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11609656/d7d98109e6468d8b3b67f1a02939fc575fb60e92.png[/img]

After 9 long years, the wait is finally over! Pythagoria: The Finals is here, bringing the beloved puzzle game back with exciting new features and even more brain-teasing challenges.

We’ve kept everything that made the original Pythagoria a fan favorite — the simple yet captivating concept, the geometric elegance, and the satisfying sense of discovery — and built on it with fresh ideas to make your gameplay experience even more enjoyable.

While we don’t have a release date just yet, [b]we need your help to bring the game to life sooner![/b] [b]Add Pythagoria: The Finals to your Steam wishlist today and encourage your friends to do the same.[/b] The more support we get, the sooner we can release the game and share this exciting experience with you.

In Pythagoria: The Finals, we set out to honor the spirit of mathematics, youth, Greece, and the competitive drive that made the original game so special. We also dedicate this new chapter to the memories of those who were instrumental in creating the first Pythagoria, but are no longer with us. Their contributions continue to inspire us as we bring this sequel to life.

We're planning to share more information in the coming months, so stay tuned.

For more information, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/909710/Pythagoria_The_Finals/]visit the Steam page[/url].

notes.title: Pythagoria v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Major update to the game just went live.

[h1]Visual Rework[/h1]
Most of the puzzles were redrawn to remove "visual inconsistency" to represent shapes slightly more precisely; all the puzzles that couldn't be represented more accurately because of balancing the game were left untouched.

I'd like to encourage players who had problems with visual issues to try the updated version of puzzles.

[h1]Trading Cards[/h1]

Trading Cards are available now.

[h1]Complete list of other big changes made this week[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Extended version of help with new pages added;
    [*] Added windowed mode;
    [*] Pencil drawing tool fix for Radeon graphic cards.
[/list]
I want to thank everyone for the great feedback, patience and support. 
Rock on, and enjoy experiencing Pythagoria!

notes.title: Wot I Think: Pythagoria
notes.notes:
Pythagoria [Steam page] is an awful lot more like maths homework than it is a regular puzzle game. But if you’re a giant weirdo like me, then you might secretly have rather enjoyed maths homework (the only homework I ever did). In fact, if you’re a colossal weirdo, you might have spent a good proportion of a sabbatical a couple of years ago sitting under a tree in a park with a pad and pen, re-learning algebra from a mobile app. So yes, Pythagoria does rather appeal, despite that.
